j_summary: Runa is a pragmatic and cautious individual who prioritizes maintaining their own food stores while attempting to form productive fishing partnerships, particularly with the trustworthy Finn.
Ada focused exclusively on her own food security by maintaining a tight, exclusive partnership with Cora while publicly condemning Nils's dishonesty.
Greta is a solitary and neutral observer who consistently avoids colony drama to maintain her own food stores while expressing a general concern for the group's stability.
Nils is a manipulative opportunist who systematically lied and made fake promises of food to Finn and others to maintain a social shield and maximize his own hoard.
Kira is a solitary and principled observer who focuses on maintaining personal security while aggressively calling out dishonesty and advocating for others' fair treatment.
Cora is a principled and reliable colony member who maintains a strict partnership with Ada and consistently pressures Nils for honesty and accountability.
Finn is an exceptionally kind and altruistic member who prioritizes the colony's well-being and maintains a patient, forgiving attitude even when repeatedly deceived by Nils.
Pell is a principled and solitary worker who maintains a private food reserve for the colony's benefit and consistently advocates for honesty and fairness in public.
Sven is a solitary individual who avoids social conflict and power dynamics, preferring to fish alone and observing the colony's drama from a distance.
Ines is a solitary and honest individual who prefers working alone while quietly monitoring the colony's needs to provide food to those struggling.
Tova is a peace-seeking individualist who prefers working alone but actively supports the colony's stability through food donations and gentle mediation.
Kira is a cooperative and transparent member who prioritizes finding a reliable fishing partner to maintain food stability.
Greta is a compulsive liar who systematically hoards food while maintaining a facade of generosity through a cycle of fake promises and fake clerical errors.
Bram focuses on maximizing his own food stores through a consistent partnership with reliable fishers while aggressively shaming Greta for her dishonesty.
Wren is a principled and reliable member who prioritizes colony stability and honesty, characterized by a persistent public crusade against Greta's dishonesty and a loyal partnership with Bram.
Nils is a pragmatic and opportunistic individual who focuses on maximizing his own food supply through strategic partnerships while aggressively calling out others' dishonesty.
Pell is a highly altruistic and honest member who consistently supports Oona and manages the colony's winter store with transparency while publicly pressuring Dov to be honest.
Finn is a rigid moralist who spent the entire record fishing alone and relentlessly shaming a fellow member for dishonesty.
Elin is a compassionate and honest individual who prefers solitude but consistently supports Oona and publicly pressures Dov to be truthful.
Oona is a principled and disciplined individual who maintained a loyal partnership with Bram and relentlessly held Dov accountable for his debts before eventually showing a gesture of mercy.
Greta acted as a moral compass for the colony, relentlessly calling out Dov's dishonesty and forming strategic partnerships to support Oona and maintain stability.

Bram is a fiercely loyal partner who consistently supports Oona and publicly shames Dov for his dishonesty.
Ada is a solitary and cautious individual who avoids colony drama and keeps her food supplies secret while repeatedly publicly shaming Dov for his dishonesty.
